policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Section 2 - Purpose
(1)
To set out the policy and procedures for the appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors.
(2)
The process will be based on academic achievement and will be conducted in a transparent and equitable manner and with due regard for confidentiality.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Section 3 - Scope
(3)
Applies to all academic staff of the University.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy

Key Decisions

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Section 5 - Policy Statement
(4)
To attract, appoint, and retain leading, world-class academic staff who have established stellar records of academic achievement and have attained international distinction for their research and scholarly work.
(5)
Such appointments are consistent with the University’s strategic objectives and will add to the University’s prestige as a world-class research and higher education institution.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Funding
(8)
The funding for such appointments shall be provided from the budget of the area in which the appointment is located.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Term of Appointment
(9)
Appointment normally will be for a fixed-term of five years.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Process
(10)
The Vice-Chancellor will consider a recommendation from a Deputy Vice-Chancellor or a Provost and may initiate the process by appointing a selection committee and inviting the relevant Dean to submit a proposal.
(11)
Proposals will be assessed by the committee against the criteria outlined in Section 64, clauses 6 and 7.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Proposals
(12)
Proposals should include:
a statement addressing the criteria for appointment as a La Trobe University Distinguished Professor;
a copy of the proposed appointee’s curriculum vitae;
the names and contact details of three disciplinary experts who can attest to the proposed appointee’s international reputation.
a statement of support by the Dean and indication of the funding source, internal or external.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Selection Committee
(13)
Composition:
Vice-Chancellor (as Chair)
Provost
Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Academic)
Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research and Innovation)
(14)
The Vice-Chancellor may appoint additional committee members, as appropriate. The committee membership must meet the University’s requirements for gender representation as outlined in the
Selection Committee Policy
.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Approval
(15)
The Vice-Chancellor has the authority to approve the appointment.
(16)
Appointments will be reported to the Academic Board.

policy_title: Appointment of La Trobe University Distinguished Professors Policy
text:
Section 7 - Definitions
(17)
For the purpose of this Policy and Procedure:
La Trobe Univesity Distinguished Professor: leading world-class academic researchers or scholars, who have achieved international distinction for the outstanding quality of their research and scholarly work.
